content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Cutting tools, first aid and safety products sold through retail and distributors; not paper protective packaging systems."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients and additives sold to formulators; no packaging machines or paper consumables."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Branded shelf-stable and frozen foods sold to grocers; unrelated to industrial packaging systems."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and industrial components for construction and transport; different products and customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to manufacturers; not packaging systems or paper-based consumables."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Packaged meat and prepared foods sold to grocers and foodservice; a food business, not packaging."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, fiberglass insulation and glass reinforcements for construction; different products and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Custom machined and molded prototype parts for engineers; a contract manufacturer, not packaging systems or consumables."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Branded household foil, wrap and bags sold to consumers via retail; consumer disposables, not B2B protective packaging systems."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Canned and frozen vegetables and snack foods sold to grocers; a food processor, not packaging."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Metal and plastic containers and closures for consumer goods makers; rigid packaging, unlike Ranpak's paper machines for shipping protection."}]}
